fields.description: VELA is OMNIYAT’s 38-residence waterfront development on Marasi Bay. Three- and four-bedroom homes sit alongside penthouses and a five-bedroom Sky Palace, with large terraces and selected private pools.

overview: VELA brings waterfront residences to Marasi Bay, with architecture by Foster + Partners and interiors by Gilles & Boissier. Its accommodation includes Marina and Sky homes, penthouses and a Sky Palace.
Dorchester Collection is named as lifestyle provider. À la carte services and access arrangements for neighbouring properties require confirmation in the ownership documents.
research.locationNote: On Marasi Bay within Business Bay, Dubai. The primary page identifies waterfront arrival and marina-facing communal spaces; no precise travel-time promises are adopted.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 43m as a launch price. It is not a current available-unit quotation; the reviewed developer page publishes no price. Confirm inventory, furnishing specification, fees and final terms for the selected residence.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 5% booking, 55% during construction and 40% handover. These are reference stages, not a retrieved developer instalment calendar; dates and conditions remain subject to the selected SPA.
research.handoverNote: The current developer page gives Q4 2027. Earlier third-party 2026 dates are not adopted. No primary construction inspection report or completion certificate was retrieved.

facts.value: L03-01: typologies 7,368.11 versus supplement 7,373.39 sq ft. L01-01 and L19-01 component sums differ from printed totals by 0.01 sq ft.

unresolved: The retrieved plans omit detailed four-bedroom Sky, penthouse and Sky Palace drawings; their areas remain brochure guides. All totals include terraces.
Brochure Marina minima 4,253 and 7,262 sq ft differ from the retrieved drawings; both scopes are retained rather than assumed identical.

Current developer inventory, dated payment calendar, service charges and completion certification remain unverified. No percentage from an indirect construction database is presented as a primary inspection.
